name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 69 – Am 17
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 69a. Underlines that increases in defence investment should not compete with other public investment priorities including social expenditure, territorial cohesion and the climate transition, which are all relevant to our European security; reiterates that the most effective way to maintain such priorities is to release fresh investments for defence rather than repurposing already earmarked funding; recalls, furthermore, that financing orientations should be anchored in a whole-of-society approach to resilience and, therefore, need to be broadly supported by European citizens, and that this support needs to be sustainable in the long term;
